items.title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
items.summary: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

items.title: Call-buying bonanza around Trump's Hyperliquid comments includes some eyebrow-raising trades
items.summary: President Donald Trump hinted that regulation may be in the works for Hyperliquid. Interesting trading activity followed.

items.title: Meta's legal troubles has options traders eyeing the 'jade lizard'
items.summary: One of the many beauties of options trading is the ability to make money on a rangebound stock. Shares of Meta Platforms are presenting that opportunity right now.

items.title: Carvana shares are under pressure this week as Mark Walter probe fuels investor jitters
items.summary: The scrutiny raised questions about what could happen to Walter's Carvana position if fallout from the investigation pressures him to raise cash.

items.title: Contrarian vs. the crowd: One trader made a massive bet against chip stocks
items.summary: The biggest single options trade in the entire market Monday was a $129 million bet against the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.
